The '''Korad system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korad]].<ref name="PotG3" />
